question:
Let \(PQ\) be a line segment of a fixed length \(L\) with its two ends \(P\) and \(Q\) sliding along the \(X\)-axis and \(Y\)-axis respectively. Complete the rectangle \(OPRQ\) where \(O\) is the origin. Show that the locus of the foot of the perpendicular drawn from \(R\) on \(PQ\) is given by
\[
x^{2/3}+y^{2/3}=L^{2/3}.
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
